## Notes

- "zero third-party" means the component ships no vendor/ directory and imports nothing outside first-party code.
- Dev-only dependencies never ship in the delivery tarball; they exist for module test suites only.
- Vendored libraries keep their upstream licences; attribution ships in each vendor/ directory and in NOTICE.
- Regenerate with `node scripts/gen-dependency-matrix.mjs --write`; `--check` fails if the checked-in copy is stale.
